newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight rates widen, one-week steady.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight rates widen, one-week steady.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound widened in a very liquid private sector market on Thursday to between 9 7/8 percent and 10 1/4 percent from Wednesday's range of 10 1/8 and 10 1/4 percent, bankers said.
The market is usually liquid before the Friday-Saturday bank weekend.
Bankers said one-week rates were steady between 10 1/4 and 10 1/2 percent, although one banker said he dealt at 9 7/8 percent.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
